subject: Business Models
title: Shopping Malls
description: A micro-lesson that makes Shopping Malls usable.

hook.text: Southdale Center opened in Minnesota in 1956—the world's first fully enclosed shopping mall.

buildup.text: Victor Gruen designed it as a community center: shops, restaurants, art, all under one climate-controlled roof.

discovery.text: Malls used 'anchor tenants'—big department stores at each end that pulled foot traffic past smaller shops.

twist.text: Gruen later called malls 'an ugly land of greed.' He hated what his concept became.

climax.text: E-commerce and shifting tastes killed hundreds of malls. 25% of US malls may close by 2030.

punchline.text: The mall's inventor hated malls. Now they're dying anyway.

quiz.question: What strategy did malls use to drive foot traffic?
